title: Day 1: an AI built this iPhone game in one day #shorts
description:
Snake, but your body is the billiard cushion.

Tamahebi is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Pull back, let go, and roll. Your trail becomes your body, and you can bounce off yourself to reach the balls. 800+ stages, all verified solvable.

Tamahebi: Snake Billiards - coming soon to the App Store
https://enludus.com/products/tamahebi

Follow for Day 2 tomorrow.

#indiegame #iphonegame #puzzlegame #ai #gamedev
